notes: Explicit semantic projection for the G4 craftsmanship two-column slice (issue #25): the observed source names its text layers 'Overline'/'Title'/'Body' (no SLOT-role naming convention) and its media slots are plain frames carrying media fills, so this reason-carrying document is the recorded human decision that assigns composer roles to observed locators. The two-column roles (column-primary/column-secondary) declare WHICH observed slot containers become the native columns and in which order; inline-media declares which observed frames become native image elements inside their column. Every assignment is reviewable; nothing here invents nodes, content or asset URLs.
